features: Frozen compact causal M1 microstructure plus closed M15/H1/H4/D1 context and cyclic time features.
training: 2023 resolved rows only with 30-minute overlap weighting.
calibration: Three expanding 2023 folds with a six-hour purge. Concatenated OOF predictions are the fixed reference distribution.
frozen_model_replay: The final model trained on all resolved 2023 rows is not refit for 2025 or 2026. The model and numeric gate selected in 2024 are replayed unchanged.
selection: Choose within each sleeve using 2024 only. A setting must retain at least 60 one-position trades. Strict sleeve admission still requires unchanged 2025 confirmation.
